LanguageData.MBDD_RangedDeepDrill_CommandToggle_Enabl: Select a specific ore to drill. If that ore is unavailable, the drill will stop until it appears again or another target is selected.
LanguageData.MBDD_RangedDeepDrill_NoTargetSelected: Targeted drilling: no target ore selected.
LanguageData.MBDD_RangedDeepDrill_TargetOreExhausted: The targeted ore ({ORE}) has been exhausted on this map. The drill will stop until the ore appears again or another target is selected.
LanguageData.MBDD_RangedDeepDrill_TargetOreUnavailabl: Targeted ore ({ORE}) is not currently available on this map.
LanguageData.MBDD_RangedDeepDrill_ResourcesExhaustedF: Deep resources have been exhausted. The drill will automatically continue producing {RESOURCE}.
LanguageData.MBDD_RangedDeepDrill_ResourcesExhaustedN: Deep resources have been exhausted, and no fallback stone is available. The drill will stop.
